title: Dark viewer card cycling marks with blur swaps
summary: One dark rounded card on flat light grey lights up a mark, then swaps it for the next every 1.5 s: the old mark slides left into blur, the new one sharpens in from the right, its name wipes in below. Loops back to empty.
use_when: Showing an integrations, partners or product-family row one mark at a time
A silent loop for a landing page hero or social card about a logo set
Before/after of a mark evolution, one state per slot
Any 4:5 or 1:1 post where a calm, repeatable rhythm beats a full film

look.type_style: neutral grotesk, medium, sentence case; grey captions ~2.8 % H above and below the card; white mark name ~1.4 % H; tiny bold+regular label in the top pill

sfx.event: first mark lights on inside the card

structure.shot: empty dark rounded card with soft drop shadow on light grey; caption above and below fade in; first mark lights on, top pill drops open
structure.camera: near-static: zoom -0.2 %/s, pan 2 px/s (motion.json), not visible on sheets
structure.motion: captions fade 0 -> 1 over f0-f23 (easings.inOutSine, ±0.25 s); mark appears dim at f11, light-on S-curve to full by f24; pill grows down from the card top f14-f20 on springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); name fades in f17-f24

structure.shot: swap to mark 2 inside the same card; its one-word name under it
structure.motion: out: mark slides ~25 % card width left, blur 0 -> ~12 px, fades in 4 fr (easings.inExpo); in: from ~20 % right, blur -> 0, slides to centre in 7 fr (easings.outExpo); old name drops ~4 px and cuts, new name wipes in left to right with a feathered edge over 8 fr; hold 37 fr

structure.shot: swap to mark 3, name under it
structure.motion: same swap: out 4 fr left + blur, in 6-7 fr from right on easings.outExpo, name wipe 8 fr; hold ~38 fr; period 45 fr

structure.shot: swap to mark 4, a two-part name under it
structure.motion: same swap; incoming mark sharp by f132 (5 fr after start); name wipe ~10 fr for the longer name

structure.shot: swap to mark 5, an outline mark, name under it
structure.motion: same swap; incoming mark sharp by f179 (7 fr); name wipe 8 fr; hold 38 fr

structure.shot: swap back to mark 1 (the loop closes on the opening mark), holds
structure.motion: same swap, incoming sharp by f224 (7 fr); hold 27 fr, shorter than the others

structure.shot: lights off: mark, name and pill dim away, captions fade out; empty dark card holds to the loop point
structure.motion: mark and name dim f251-f266 (reverse light-on, easings.inOutSine); pill retracts up into the card edge by f260 on springs.ui; captions fade 1 -> ~0.1 over f258-f282; empty card holds f266-f300

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, surface for the card, fg for marks and names, muted for captions, accent for the live dot
params.content.marks: 4-6 marks (SVG or vector), each with a one- or two-word name; the first is repeated at the end to close the loop
params.content.label: short label in the top pill, 2 words
params.timing.period: frames between swaps at 30 fps (default 45 = 1.5 s)
params.timing.swap: swap length in frames (default 7: out 4 fr overlapping in 7 fr)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0, 1.1, 2.6, 4.1, 5.6, 7.1, 8.2: swaps start at f37, f82, f127, f172, f217 (period 45 fr); the swap is directional (out left, in from right) and blurred, a cross-dissolve of 4-7 fr, not a centred fade. The name under the mark wipes in left to right with a feathered blur edge (Proposed term label-feather-wipe); the swap itself is Proposed term slide-blur-swap. Loop: frame 0 and frame 299 are both the empty card. Card and shadow never move; the only scale change is a sub-0.5 %/s drift. Accent: a small green live dot in the pill (#5FD068 approx, not in palettegen output). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
